frequency_question: What proportion of announced major industrial/transport subsidy schemes are officially finalized and implemented within a comparable window of ~10-12 months?
membership_rule: Includes: formally announced draft or proposed central government financial incentive/subsidy schemes for industrial or transport manufacturing sectors. Excludes: routine budgetary allocations, tax rate revisions, or general policy statements without specific credit/subsidy frameworks.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named major schemes; represents the primary corpus of recent central-level green/transport manufacturing subsidy rollouts.
known_gaps: Some minor sub-schemes or delayed drafts that underwent restructuring are omitted as they fell outside standard major notification tracks.
validity_reason: Bureaucratic procedures and priority timelines for national EV and transport manufacturing policies remain stable over this multi-year administrative cycle.
